note: _ferculum_. The context requires the meaning “carriage” (Greek φορεῖον) rather than “meal” (a meaning common in medieval Latin).

The end of the verse as printed in the Clementina is problematic: “in the midst he covered with love the daughters of Jerusalem.” The NVg revises: _medium eius stratum ebeneum_ – in its middle is an inset of ebony. The “daughters of Jerusalem” belong to the following sentence.
